notes.title: Optimization update and new content!
notes.content:
A major update has been released that significantly improves the game’s performance!

This update was a crucial step to move forward with the upcoming 8AM titles.

Starting in October, development will begin on four brand-new 8AM games.

Each game will feature 100 anomalies set across unique locations:

[list]
[*] Office
[*] Swimming Pool
[*] Shopping Mall
[*] Subway
[/list]

This release reflects my commitment to the 8AM community, as I had promised to deliver new 8AM experiences within this year.

notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE
notes.content:
Halloween has arrived at 8AM!

from the 1st to the 28th there will be pre-Halloween decoration and from the 28th to the 4th the official Halloween decoration, this has been automated so every year the update will automatically be put on, at Christmas I will make a similar update that will remain over time.

If you have purchased Imposter Doll they both use the same automated system!
